<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
import copy
def snap(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    # yellow pixels on board
    yel=[(r,c) for r in range(9,41) for c in range(13,51) if a[r][c]=='Y']
    # ball pixels
    ball=[(r,c) for r in range(48,60) for c in range(28,46) if a[r][c] in 'bb']
    # icon states
    bars=[(c,a[42][c]) for c in range(13,51) if a[42][c] in 'Bw']
    stems=[(c,a[44][c]) for c in range(13,51) if a[44][c] in 'Bw']
    return dict(yel=len(yel), yelset=frozenset(yel), ballc=(min(p[1] for p in ball),max(p[1] for p in ball),min(p[0] for p in ball),max(p[0] for p in ball)) if ball else None, bars=tuple(bars), stems=tuple(stems))
before=snap(current_frame)
print("before:", {k:(v if k!='yelset' else len(v)) for k,v in before.items()})
res=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':55,'col':36}])
after=snap(current_frame)
print("res:", res.get('no_impact'), res.get('board_changed'), res.get('level_completed'), res.get('done'))
print("after :", {k:(v if k!='yelset' else len(v)) for k,v in after.items()})
for k in before:
    if before[k]!=after[k]: print("CHANGED",k, before[k] if k!='yelset' else len(before[k]), "->", after[k] if k!='yelset' else len(after[k]))
print("yellow set changed:", before['yelset']!=after['yelset'])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def snap(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    # yellow pixels on board
    yel=[(r,c) for r in range(9,41) for c in range(13,51) if a[r][c]=='Y']
